task: Replace the obsolete combined public shipping/payment authority with independent /szallitas and /fizetes authorities while preserving storefront runtime behavior, template navigation, and Product Owner proof.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Product Owner explicitly required shipping and payment to be separate public pages, but canonical route integrity, sitemap authority, browser handoff convergence and regressions still preserve the obsolete combined /szallitas-es-fizetes authority.
observableOutcomes: The storefront serves independent /szallitas and /fizetes pages with canonical metadata and customer-facing runtime content.
No canonical navigation, sitemap, showroom surface, Product Owner handoff convergence or regression test retains the combined public /szallitas-es-fizetes authority.
Legacy /oldal/szallitas and /oldal/fizetes entry points converge to the new direct public authorities without creating duplicate public truth ownership.
unresolvedRisks: Template shell links may contain indirect or generated consumers that are not visible from a simple lexical route search and must be covered by semantic/reference synchronization.
Moving public information rendering must not discard live commerce settings or merchant-owned content semantics.
Template Factory route convergence must remain executable after replacing one combined navigation destination with two independent destinations.

in: Public shipping and payment route authority, canonical metadata, sitemap and legacy-route convergence.
Template route integrity, shopper navigation and Product Owner handoff consumers of the obsolete combined route.
Adversarial regressions proving the explicit Product Owner instruction remains durable.
out: Admin payment and shipping configuration pages, which are a separate operational settings authority.
Checkout workflow steps that legitimately group shipping and payment inside one purchase flow.
Provider configuration, order persistence and payment processing behavior.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This repair exercises the new PO-instruction and semantic execution foundations on the exact failure class that previously escaped Plan Before Code. It therefore requires repository-aware consumer discovery, explicit forbidden-state proof, exact-head runtime/build verification and adversarial regression without expanding into unrelated commerce internals.

acceptanceCriteria: Both /szallitas and /fizetes are real public route authorities with direct canonical metadata and active storefront shell rendering.
The combined /szallitas-es-fizetes route module and every canonical route key, URL and public navigation assertion for it are removed.
Legacy generic information URLs converge to the direct route authorities instead of remaining competing canonical destinations.
Template Factory Product Owner route convergence independently proves both Szállítás and Fizetés destinations.
The existing stress regression from PR #645 becomes a canonical regression and passes unchanged in intent.
invariants: Admin shipping/payment settings and checkout provider behavior remain outside this public-route refactor.
Shipping content continues to reflect active shipping options and free-shipping threshold; payment content continues to reflect active payment options.
The canonical 14 Page Schema matrix is not expanded or mutated by this public information route split.
No redirect or alias may point the new direct routes back to the removed combined authority.
forbiddenStates: display-label:Szállítás és fizetés as a canonical public navigation destination
direct /szallitas or /fizetes route missing while tests are rewritten to weaker expectations
merchant public information content or active commerce settings silently dropped

failureModes: A stale combined route remains reachable from sitemap, template shell or browser handoff despite direct routes existing.
One direct page is implemented while the other remains a generic /oldal slug, recreating asymmetric authority.
Template Factory navigation changes but route presentation mapping still classifies the removed combined route.
Tests pass lexically while runtime metadata or build route generation still exposes the obsolete URL.
edgeCases: Merchant has previously seeded szallitas/fizetes information content.
Mobile navigation and footer navigation both contain the affected destinations.
Template Factory preview rewrites legal/content routes through preview query parameters.

alternatives.summary: Create independent direct route authorities and converge old generic information entry points onto them.
alternatives.reason: This satisfies the explicit PO URL authority, removes duplicate canonical truth, and preserves compatibility through one-way convergence.

alternatives.summary: Create /szallitas and /fizetes as redirects to the existing /oldal slugs.
alternatives.reason: The requested direct routes would not own canonical content and the old generic route would remain the real authority.

alternatives.summary: Keep the combined route as a compatibility alias while adding two new pages.
alternatives.reason: The Product Owner explicitly forbids the combined public authority; retaining it would preserve the proven instruction-retention defect.

specialistReviews.finding: The public authority must be one-way: direct routes own shipping/payment while legacy generic entry points may only converge toward them.
specialistReviews.resolution: Remove the combined route and update route-integrity/sitemap consumers; prevent reverse aliasing.

specialistReviews.finding: Splitting one footer destination into two can increase navigation density and break showroom convergence assumptions.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve both destinations as independent required links and update Product Owner browser convergence to prove each one rather than hiding one behind the other.

specialistReviews.finding: The current generic system-info route already contains correct live shipping and payment runtime semantics that must not be lost.
specialistReviews.resolution: Reuse a shared server-rendered commerce information component and make direct routes the canonical entry points.

specialistReviews.finding: PR #645 proves that documentation/chat memory was insufficient because the combined authority survived previous plans.
specialistReviews.resolution: Promote the exact split expectation into canonical regression while retaining machine-readable PO instruction enforcement.

challenge.scenario: The new direct routes exist but sitemap still advertises the combined URL.
challenge.finding: Search engines and route authority would continue to expose the forbidden state.
challenge.resolution: Replace the combined sitemap entry with both direct routes and regression-test both URLs.

challenge.scenario: Header/footer links are updated but Template Factory handoff still clicks the combined label.
challenge.finding: Technical quality could pass while Product Owner browser convergence silently skips the new split.
challenge.resolution: Require separate browser convergence checks for Szállítás and Fizetés.

challenge.scenario: The old /oldal/szallitas and /oldal/fizetes pages remain independently canonical.
challenge.finding: Two URL families would own the same public information truth.
challenge.resolution: Converge legacy generic entry points to the direct authorities and make direct metadata canonical.

challenge.scenario: Shipping and payment UI is duplicated into two new route files.
challenge.finding: Future copy/runtime fixes could drift between route implementations.
challenge.resolution: Move shared server rendering to one commerce-information component consumed by both direct routes.

challenge.scenario: The combined page is deleted before semantic consumers are updated.
challenge.finding: Template or regression consumers can become stale and only fail late.
challenge.resolution: Use the execution route plus Reference Sync and keep the stress assertions as explicit negative proof.

challenge.scenario: The route split changes checkout or admin configuration semantics.
challenge.finding: A public information repair could accidentally expand into transaction/provider authority.
challenge.resolution: Keep admin configuration and checkout flow explicitly out of scope and assert no related provider code is edited.

challenge.scenario: A merchant has no active provider options.
challenge.finding: The new direct pages could render empty or crash despite nominal route existence.
challenge.resolution: Preserve the current explicit empty-state cards for both shipping and payment.

challenge.scenario: Tests are weakened to accept any two labels without proving the old authority disappeared.
challenge.finding: The original defect could survive under renamed tests.
challenge.resolution: Retain negative assertions for route key, URL and combined display label alongside positive direct-route checks.

proofPlan: Run Plan Before Code on a plan-only commit and require the generated semantic execution route to reconcile every PO-instruction-required edit before implementation starts.
Replay the PR #645 split expectation as a canonical regression together with public route, sitemap, template navigation and Product Owner convergence tests.
Require Reference Sync/Edit-Time Guard to report no stale combined route consumers after the route module deletion.
Run full Quality Tests, TypeScript and Production Build on the exact implementation HEAD.
Require Completion Truth to verify positive direct routes and negative absence of the combined authority before lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: The public storefront exposes independent canonical /szallitas and /fizetes authorities and no canonical combined shipping/payment authority remains.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: The combined /szallitas-es-fizetes route, shipping-payment key or canonical public label must not reappear.

requirements.requirement: Sitemap, template shell navigation, showroom surfaces and Product Owner browser convergence all consume the two separate destinations without stale combined references.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No stale combined route consumer may remain in the affected public/template execution route.

requirements.requirement: The exact implementation head typechecks and production-builds with both direct public route modules and preserved empty/live commerce information states.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: The route split must not introduce TypeScript or production build regressions.
